title: dactylorhiza × hallii subsp. nummiana
intro: Dactylorhiza × hallii subsp. nummiana, commonly known as the Himalayan Orchid, is a hybrid orchid species known for its unique characteristics and medicinal properties. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Himalayan region, to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza × hallii subsp. nummiana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which have been shown to exhibit anti-diabetic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-cancerous activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential applications of this plant.
